clips.title: The story
paras: Bristleback quilboar raid Camp Narache from Brambleblade Ravine, cut into Red Cloud Mesa’s northeastern edge. Young tauren braves enter the ravine to defend their homeland and prove their strength.

Brambleblade Ravine cuts into Red Cloud Mesa’s northeastern edge, its thorny briars and quilboar camps guarding the Bristleback tribe. From this den, the Bristlebacks raid Camp Narache and threaten young tauren coming of age. Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle leads the shamans and warriors who dwell deep in the ravine with trained battleboars. For the Shu'halo, striking into the canyon is both a rite of passage and a hard need if the plains are to be safe.
